evidence: Spain's newly crowned World Cup champions were greeted by a million fans as the team arrived for the victory parade in Madrid.

The players, some shirtless, others holding drinks, set off on their procession along the main arteries in the city centre where a sea of fans in red and yellow were waiting, with the destination Cibeles square.

nary_nodes.label: World Cup final victory
evidence: Spain's 1-0 victory over Argentina in New Jersey on Sunday, secured by a Ferran Torres strike in extra-time

Spain's 1-0 victory over Argentina in New Jersey on Sunday, secured by a Ferran Torres strike in extra-time, has sparked an outpouring of national pride in the football-mad country, whose only other World Cup triumph came in 2010.

nary_nodes.label: Celebration party
evidence: On Monday morning, the Castellana, Madrid's main avenue, bore the marks of a boozy evening

evidence: a 13-year-old boy was killed around midnight in the town of Ciudad Rodrigo in the west, after a fountain crumbled under the weight of supporters who had climbed onto it to celebrate.
